2111930328524931425.en_summary: Michael Sikand (@michaelsikand) argues the biggest US fumble was not putting social security in the S&P 500, questioning why so few Americans benefited from the country's economic growth and suggesting it should have been the default.

2111929284776587760.en_summary: Scott Melker (@scottmelker) shares Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi calling going public in the US the slowest piece of financial plumbing left, describing it as expensive, time-consuming (quarters to years), involving extensive audits, controls, filings, and debates with people unfamiliar with the business.

2111929284776587760.ko_summary: Scott Melker(@scottmelker)는 Kraken 공동 CEO Arjun Sethi가 미국 상장을 남은 가장 느린 금융 배관이라고 부른 내용을 공유하며, 비싸고 시간 소모적이며(분기에서 년 단위) 광범위한 감사, 통제, 신고 및 사업에 익숙하지 않은 사람들과의 논쟁을 포함한다고 설명했다.
